ValidationRule.description: If Qualifying integration is filled in, Int Partner can not be blank. Updated per SAL-2584 BOPI-600 updated to prevent auto renewals from stopping
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Profile.Name <> "System Administrator", $Profile.Name <> "B - Looker", $User.Alias <> "Workato", OR( NOT(ISPICKVAL(Qualifying_Integration__c , "")) ), OR( NOT(ISPICKVAL(Qualifying_Integration__c , "Non Partner - Custom Integration")) ), ISBLANK(Integration_Partner__c), (DateValue(CreatedDate) > Date(2023, 08, 01)), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Type, "Auto Renewal")) ) && Opp_Val_Bypass__c = false
ValidationRule.errorMessage: If there is a Qualifying Integration you must fill in the Integration Partner field.
